newsitem.title: UK: UK union leader praises budget on jobs,investment.
newsitem.headline: UK union leader praises budget on jobs,investment.

text.p: The Trades Union Congress (TUC), British unions' main umbrella body, said on Wednesday it welcomed Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown's first budget as encouraging for stability, jobs and investment.
"This is a brilliant first budget. The Chancellor's priorities of stability, investment, jobs and opportunities for all are spot on," TUC general secretary John Monks said in a statement.
The unions, under the leadership of Monks, have given strong support for the new Labour government's commitment to reducing long-term unemployment.
"Trades unions will want to play their full part in the bold and imaginative programme to boost the skills and adaptability of our workforce, particularly our young people," Monks said.
He added the TUC particularly welcomed the government's national child strategy, which provides for childcare.
